offering_description.value: Develops and sells inhaled drug products for diabetes and rare lung diseases, mainly an inhaled insulin for adults and children with diabetes. Products are made in-house using a dry-powder inhaler platform and sold to patients through prescriptions via pharmacies.

primary_products.value: inhaled insulin; inhaled treprostinil dry powder; dry-powder inhaler devices

primary_services.value: contract manufacturing and supply for partners; research and development collaboration

customer_segment.value: B2C: patients with diabetes and lung disease receiving prescribed therapies; B2B: wholesalers, specialty pharmacies, and licensing partners

end_markets.value: diabetes care; pulmonary arterial hypertension; rare lung disease; pharmaceuticals

revenue_model.value: product sales: inhaled insulin sold via wholesalers and pharmacies; licensing or royalties: royalties and milestones from licensed inhaled products; service fees: manufacturing and supply to partners; healthcare reimbursement: payer and insurer reimbursement for prescribed drugs
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; service fees; healthcare reimbursement

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: produces inhaled drug powders and devices in-house, sold to wholesalers and pharmacies; brand owner: develops and markets branded pharmaceutical products to prescribers

geography_served.value: US national: Commercial sales in the United States, partners hold ex-US rights

specialization.value: related lines: inhaled insulin, inhaled pulmonary drugs and dry-powder inhaler technology

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: wholesalers and specialty pharmacies; direct sales: sales force calling on endocrinologists and primary care prescribers; partners / resellers: licensing partners marketing products outside the US
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: drugs and combination products requiring FDA approval, GMP manufacturing, foreign regulators for partners

notes: Details are from memory and may be partly out of date, such as pipeline status and partner arrangements.
